llm_query: Hi. I want to create a dataset with a metadata table for data generated from in vivo electrophysiological recordings in the mouse cortex. We are using multielectrode arrays to capture time series data of neuronal firing patterns during different behavioral tasks. The recordings include both local field potentials and spike trains. Additional data such as stimulus parameters and behavioral annotations are also included. The data is intended to investigate the neural correlates of decision-making processes in the mouse brain.

topic: Human EEG Response to Visual Stimuli
llm_query: Hi. I want to create a dataset with a metadata table for data generated from EEG recordings in human subjects. We are presenting various visual stimuli to participants and recording the brain's electrical activity to study event-related potentials (ERPs). The experimental setup includes detailed descriptions of the stimuli, timing of presentations, and subject response data. The data is intended to analyze the neural mechanisms underlying visual perception and cognitive processing.

The experiments involve capturing multidimensional image data of neuronal activity in response to various odorant stimuli using a two-photon microscope. We also annotate regions of interest within the brain and include information about the odorant concentrations and exposure times. The data is intended to explore the neural coding of olfactory information in fruit flies.
